description: Whitelee SCADA Dataset is a data set deposited in University of Strathclyde by its authors David Pattison. Supervisory Control and Data Acquisition (SCADA) and Metmast data from Whitelee wind farm for all 140 turbines on Whitelee 1. Data is held on a MySQL database. This dataset is subject to commercial restrictions and so is unable to be made openly available and cannot be shared. Coverage: not stated; the metadata date the deposit to 2015. The formats are not stated in the metadata. Size stated: 97KB. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is not stated (no licence in the DataCite metadata read on 2026-09-29). Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked, and the coverage and resolution are those of the abstract only. It can support industrial-facility and resource studies. Related records: none catalogued yet for this repository.
